title: NFTStakerDepletion._syncBudget un-try/catch'd dispatcherHook.pull() lets an unauthorized hook DoS interactions and initiateMigration
description: NFTStakerDepletion._syncBudget calls dispatcherHook.pull() without a try/catch. A reverting or unauthorized hook therefore propagates the revert up through every code path that calls _syncBudget — staker interactions and initiateMigration — bricking them. The condition is owner-recoverable (the owner can re-point/clear the hook).
impact: An unauthorized or reverting dispatcherHook DoSes all interactions that route through _syncBudget, including initiateMigration. Availability impact only; owner-recoverable by re-pointing/clearing the hook; no theft, no loss of principal. Low severity.
attackPath: 2. A reverting/unauthorized hook causes pull() to revert.
3. The revert propagates up, bricking every _syncBudget caller — staker interactions and initiateMigration.
4. Owner recovers by re-pointing or clearing the hook.
recommendation: Wrap the dispatcherHook.pull() call in _syncBudget in a try/catch so a misbehaving hook cannot DoS interactions or migration; on failure, skip the pull (and optionally emit an event) rather than reverting the whole interaction.
